title: Palantir Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
summary: The newly filed Q2 2026 Form 10-Q supersedes the Q1 operating baseline. Q2 revenue was USD 1.935 billion, U.S. commercial revenue USD 764 million, U.S. government revenue USD 809 million, GAAP operating income USD 912 million, cash from operations USD 1.216 billion, and cash plus marketable securities USD 9.409 billion; current evidence requires a full scenario-complete valuation review.
